svc_hero_h1: The collision repair work we take on

services.title: Collision repair
services.body: Damage is measured against the factory points before the first panel comes off, and the estimate reflects what is actually bent.

services.title: Dent and body work
services.body: Panels are pulled, filled and blocked flat by hand before any primer goes on.

evidence.text: Two adults work together under the hood of a white car in the shop.

services.title: Paint and refinishing
services.body: Colour is matched to the car in front of us and blended into the next panel so the repair does not show.

evidence.text: Interior of a white SUV's cargo area staged inside the paint booth.

services.title: Engine repair
services.body: The engine comes apart far enough to find the actual fault, not far enough to run up the bill.

evidence.text: A large group of adults in matching shop shirts poses together in front of the open bay doors.

services.title: Insurance claim repairs
services.body: The estimate is written to what the damage actually is, and the car goes back the way it was.

evidence.text: They did a great job on my car and handled all the insurance paperwork.
evidence.also: They responded so rapidly to the claim and were extremely flexible with drop off and pick up times.

reviews_h2: Straight from the people who called us

reviews.author: Romik Chopra
reviews.text: This was my first time coming to them on recommendation from the dealership. They were great to deal with and Enrique did a great job communicating with geico requesting additional payment to cover additional damage that Geico did not see initially. I would come back to them whenever else I need more work done on my cars. they were quick to communicate any issues with parts and delivered in a timely manner and fixed everything making it look brand new.

reviews.author: Nick Pokriots
reviews.text: Peter at Wreck O Mend was great. Allstate referred me to them after hitting a deer and receiving extensive damage to my Silverado. Peter and the staff were attentive, informative, and even helped navigate the rental vehicle. I would recommend them as an honest and professional establishment. Peter himself truly deserves 5 stars on top of the 5 stars for the shop.

reviews.author: John Soliman
reviews.text: I recently had my vehicle, Chevy Suburban, repaired at this auto body shop, and overall I’m very satisfied with the experience. From the moment I walked in, the staff was professional, friendly, and transparent about the repair process. Enrique was fantastic! They provided a clear estimate upfront and kept me updated throughout the entire repair. The turnaround time was exactly as promised, which I really appreciated. When I picked up my car, the work looked excellent, the paint match was spot on, and the bodywork looked like nothing had ever happened. What stood out most was their attention to detail and willingness to answer questions. They took the time to explain everything and made sure I was comfortable with the repairs. HIGHLY recommend.

reviews.author: Sweet!
reviews.text: Unfortunately, I hit a deer with my Ford F-150 on Route 33 one evening, coming home from Maryland. I had damage to the front end, front bumper, front left quarter panel, drivers door, and the entire headlight was smashed. I went to 3 different collision places. WreckOMend was the 3rd one I went to the next day. I spoke with Peter who gave me a comparable estimate to the others. What set them apart in my mind was how friendly Peter was, (even though they were absolutely packed with people), how quickly he came out to look at my truck, and that he said he could have it looking almost like new in a week. (The other 2 places wanted to keep the truck for 2 weeks.) I dropped it off on a Tuesday. They called me the following Monday. I picked it up the next morning. Peter was right! You could not tell that my truck had ever been damaged! It looks incredible! I’m still amazed. Not only that but when I picked it up, I noticed that they had detailed my truck! Inside and out! I know I didn’t drop it off that way. It was dirty. I couldn’t get it washed because of the damage. They went that extra mile. If you’re looking to have collision damage repaired, CALL THIS OUTFIT! Professional, no-nonsense, friendly, they go the extra mile for their customers, and, most importantly…they do fantastic work! (see pic below. That entire side was pushed in!) Thank you to everyone at WreckOMend! J. Lowe

reviews.author: Ronny Valverde
reviews.text: I highly recommend them; they are 100% professional. Marni Levine is a true professional. They exceeded my expectations from the very first moment; they told me my car would look brand new, and that is exactly how it turned out. Today, I look at my vehicle and see the excellent work they performed.

reviews.author: tom rennhack
reviews.text: I highly recommend Wreck O Mend Auto body. Peter and his team are totally professional and take great pride in performing flawless work. They corrected problems I encountered after the initial body work performed elsewhere proved to be shoddy. I will never use another shop after this great experience. Thank you Peter and George!

reviews.author: Steven Stark
reviews.text: Wreck-O-Mend is an outstanding auto body specialist. They are professional, knowledgeable, efficient, and friendly. They did a great job on my car and handled all the insurance paperwork. I would not hesitate to use them again for any auto body need.

reviews.author: Helene
reviews.text: My Subaru was hit by a deer and sustained substantial damage to the hood, bumper, grill, and window jam. Wreck O Mend not only fixed my car to perfection but I think it runs better now than it did before. They kept me in the loop the entire time and dealt with insurance on multiple occasions. I can’t recommend them enough.

reviews.author: Sergey Volf
reviews.text: Had a great experience at wreck-o-mend. My car was scratched at a parking lot so I stopped in to see if the damage can be buffed out. Enrique was super helpful and took care of me right away. The team was able to get the scratches out without needing a more serious repair.

reviews.author: Steve Zaritsky
reviews.text: Wreck-O-Meno does outstanding body work, truly some of the best craftsmanship in the area. They keep you updated every step of the way, so you always know what’s happening with your vehicle. Pricing is fair, and they clearly break down all costs when the job is done. Highly recommended.

reviews.author: Kathy Tornberg
reviews.text: I’m so happy that I was referred to Wreck o mend. I was greeted by everyone when I went there. I was kept updated constantly. They did a great job on my car. Overall I felt that they went above and beyond to help me. Thanks also to Enrique who was incredible!

reviews.author: Robert Salerno
reviews.text: The customer service was Excellent. They couldn't do enough to make sure the my vehicle was pristine before I left. If the need ever arrise, I will definitely recommend Wreck O Mend to my friends and family.

reviews.author: Amanda Hyland
reviews.text: Wreck-o-mend is very aptly named- I would recommend them highly! Fair pricing, honest, quick turn around, and great work. I’ve had two accidents repaired here- one in 2017 and one last week. I was extremely satisfied with both interactions and outcomes. Definitely get any repairs you need completed here, you won’t be disappointed!

reviews.author: Ryan Wolff
reviews.text: My family has been using Pete and the guys for years. I had my rocker panel replaced and they did a great job. If you do right by him and his family they do right back. Definitely can't recommend them enough. Hard to find good people nowadays with quality work, but you'll definitely find that here. Thanks Pete aka Uncle Pete.

reviews.author: Michael Taras
reviews.text: Truly a wonderful experience. The entire process was stress free from start to finish. The staff was pleasant, knowledgeable, and understanding. I dealt with George and he was amazing!

reviews.author: Stacey Owens-Perrotta
reviews.text: My experience with the Freehold location on Route 33 was excellent. The shop is extremely professional and very clean and organized. Andrew Klein was exceptional with his communication and knowledge the entire time my car was in service - two weeks. The regular text messages were very helpful and ensured me my vehicle was being taken care of and in good hands. After a backend collision of my 2012 Volvo, it looks like new. Thank you so much for making this customer highly satisfied, which is very hard to find these days from service organizations. I highly recommend this business. They are pros AND they care about the quality of their work. Thank you.

reviews.author: Bonnie R
reviews.text: Peter and his staff are very friendly and great ti work with. They repaired my vehicle in a timely manner and kept us informed. The car looks great.

reviews.author: riley finnigan
reviews.text: George was great! He was super helpful and they did the repairs quick and it looks perfect. Would definitely recommend anyone to come here.

reviews.author: Paul Damante
reviews.text: I want to thank Peter Nikolatos, owber of Wreck -O-Mend ,and his staff for doing a fantastic job on my Automobile. In all the years I have been using automotive shops,I have never ever saw the expertise in the workmanship of the highly qualified people pete has working for him. And honesty their are not to many people out their upfront with people,and wreck- o mend is the real deal. I would highly recommend doing business with them. And Pete would give you the right time of day,he is one of the nicest guys to do business with. And he goes out of the way for people. You will see for yourself. WRECK-O-MEND.

reviews.author: Janette Richards
reviews.text: I had a great experience with wreckomend..George was very helpful and kept me updated on everything with my vehicle and they did a wonderful job!!!

reviews.author: Julie Filatro
reviews.text: Peter and his team were amazing from start to finish. The completed repairs looked excellent. They went above and beyond for me and I could tell the way they interacted with other customers, Peter and his team treat everyone with the greatest courtesy, care and respect. I used them before and that is why I returned as they are honest and do a fantastic job!

reviews.author: Nick Kazymirczuk
reviews.text: OK, I got my SUV back from George at WreckOMend auto body and inspected it and it looks great. Good job guys. Thank you.

reviews.author: Shea Oakley
reviews.text: I have had my "fender-benders" fixed by the guys at Wreck O Mend for about 10 years now. They not only do excellent work, but they are a pleasure to deal with as people. Peter is especially good, but so is everyone there. They might not do a cheap job, but they do a fine one, on time, and usually for very close to estimate. I have no problem recommending this company here without reservation!

reviews.author: Mon Hart
reviews.text: I highly recommend! I was recently rear ended and had to bring my car in for repairs. From start to finish, my experience with Wreck-O-Mend was fantastic! The owners are the nicest people and treat you like family. The staff was incredibly friendly, knowledgeable, and Irvan went out of his way to make sure I understood every step of the repair process. They kept me updated and were always available to answer any questions I had. Not only did I have a pleasant experience, but the quality of work was flawless. I got my car back looking brand new! Thank you Wreck-O-Mend!

reviews.author: Rich K
reviews.text: The pros at Wreck-O-mend recently went above and beyond having our Camry repaired earlier than expected, do great work at a reasonable price. I highly recommend Pete and co.

reviews.author: Leo Bortnik
reviews.text: I recently brought my car to Wreck-O-Mend Auto Body after being rear-ended, and I was pleasantly surprised by how well-run and welcoming they are. From the moment I walked in, there was a genuine family feel, everyone was so friendly and helpful. Irwin was my main point of contact, and he went above and beyond to guide me through the process with kindness and professionalism. I also had the pleasure of interacting with Angel, who was equally warm and helpful. Even though my car sadly ended up being a total loss, they made the entire experience as smooth and stress-free as possible. It’s rare to find a shop where you truly feel like family, but that’s exactly the atmosphere here. Highly recommend!

reviews.author: Katrina Barreiro
reviews.text: This is the second time I have brought one of my cars here after an accident. Both times the service and the employees were the best experience I could have possibly had. Irvin was responsive, proactive, and went above and beyond fixing stuff he didn’t even need to. Everyone was a real joy to work with. I wish I could give this place more than 5 stars. I would “Wreck O Mend” them to anyone who needs their car fixed!

reviews.author: taylor v
reviews.text: Would give six stars if I could! My car had sustained some mild damage after a multi-car accident that occurred on my property. (We had three damaged cars in my family alone!) Wreck -O-Mend was so thorough in assessing and repairing the damage on my vehicle. The car was returned to me looking brand new! They even cleaned the interior. I am so impressed with their customer service. They responded so rapidly to the claim and were extremely flexible with drop off and pick up times. Andrew handled our case wonderfully!

reviews.author: Erin Cooney
reviews.text: Hands down the best auto shop I’ve ever been to! The team at Wreck.O.Mend is friendly, professional, and really knows their stuff. They treated me with respect, explained everything in plain language, and got me back on the road fast. You can tell they truly care about their customers. Highly recommend!”

reviews.author: Michael D
reviews.text: Wreck O Mend did top notch and efficient work on my rear bumper. Andrew was very professional and knowledgeable. The vehicle was delivered detailed and in pristine condition ahead of schedule. Andrew was very easy to work with and made the process seamless. I have used Wreck O Mend over the past 20 years and I am always satisfied with their work.

reviews.author: Melissa Peck
reviews.text: I would trust them with any repair. It was helpful that they are a partner with Allstate and Enterprise Auto Rental. I hope I won't ever need them again - but in case I do, there would be no hesitation. Their entire team is fully, customer satisfaction oriented. My car was in their capable hands for over a month and Enrique kept me well-informed of their progress all along the way. I'm very happy with all the outcomes and would recommend them to anyone.

reviews.author: Luxi Zhao
reviews.text: Wreck O Mend is such a professional place, they made my car repair experience completely seamless. After a recent accident, I contacted the other party’s insurance, and Wreck O Mend reached out to me right away. They let me know I could drop off my car at my convenience for an estimate. Once the estimate was complete, they informed me the repair would take about five days and kindly helped arrange a rental car. The rental company even picked me up directly from the repair shop, and when my car was ready, I was able to return the rental right there, no extra hassle. Highly recommend for their efficiency, professionalism, and excellent customer service!

reviews.author: jenni
reviews.text: When my car needed some body repair, I didn’t even have to think twice about where I was bringing it to. This is the second time we’ve used Wreck O Mend and I refer them to anyone who needs. They’re extremely professional, GREAT at what they do, turn around time is fantastic and their customer service is second to none. Hopefully I won’t need them again (lol) but if I do, they’ll be the first to call. Thank you for all you do for your customers!!

reviews.author: Margot Camino-Derby
reviews.text: The workers at Wreck-O-Mend are professional, honest, and experienced! I would recommend anyone to get their car troubles fixed here.

reviews.author: Julisa Herrera
reviews.text: Great service from the first call to when the car was fixed and ready to drive. Thomas was so attentive and detailed oriented, he called several times to let me know how the process was going. I will definitely recommend this place

reviews.author: Beth McCauley
reviews.text: I was so totally impressed with the outcome of work on my car!!!!! The car looked brand new!!!! A very, very skilled team! Thank you!

reviews.author: Michael K
reviews.text: The BEST of the BEST!!! I specifically dealt with Enrique and Thomas as well. Very professional, clean and treats their customers and your car like their own. I have had a few cars worked on by Wreck O Mend in the past. My recent car I brought in was hit in the rear bumper, broken tail light etc. It was fully taken care of by the other persons insurance. But the communication, thoroughness and quality of work are amazing. My car looks as if it rolled off the assembly line. There is not a single gap, line etc out of place. It is an art and precision the way they operate. HIGHLY recommended and would tell anyone (I have) to take their car here!

reviews.author: Gab A
reviews.text: Wreck O Mend did a great job replacing my driver side window after it was damaged by landscapers. I was able to drop the car off and leave the key in the drop box at a time that was convenient for me and the work was done correctly and quickly. I would definitely use them again!

reviews.author: Elyse Novak
reviews.text: I leave 5 stars for wreck o mend! The work they did was fabulous! The price was great, they did the work in a timely manner and even cleaned the inside and outside of my car before returning it back to me. I am very impressed! Will definitely recommend.

reviews.author: Lynda Duffy
reviews.text: Flawless Auto Body Repair-Like the Damage Never Happened! Wreck O Mend provided reliable, high-quality auto body repair. Great work by a family owned business who clearly cares about doing the job right!

reviews.author: Robert Ewanis
reviews.text: I had an excellent experience with Wreck O Mend. They kept me up to date on the status of repairs and the car came back looking good as new. The car was also returned to me clean and free from any dirt or debris. Highly recommend them. Irvin was a please to work with.

reviews.author: Aron Buss
reviews.text: Someone hit my daughters car in a parking lot; minor scraps and a small dent in the driver side door. I had multiple estimates and only Wreck O'Mend gave me a fair price. I won't print exact numbers, but their estimate was about $1000 while the other 2 places were both over $1600. Plus, Wreck O'Mend facilities are uber nice and clean; decorated with awards they have earned over the years. To top it all off, when I picked up the car, it was not only repaired to a 'new' state, but it was cleaned and detailed. I will never take my damaged car anywhere else. Thank you Wreck O'Mend!!

reviews.author: Geo D
reviews.text: I can't say enough about Wreck-O Mend. These guys did an awesome job. Not only did they repair my front-end damaged car, it looked better than new when I picked it up. Thier attention to details was second to none. I have had car body work done at other Local shops; nothing compares to the work done here. Special thanks to Irvin, he was a true professional all the way.

reviews.author: Jared Maltese
reviews.text: They fixed my car . But robbed me of 10$ in quarters. When I said something I was just told “ my guys wouldn’t do that” in my opinion they aren’t that friendly here. The guy Thomas didn’t follow instructions I told him multiple times not to call my wife’s phone but to call mine. And yet he never once followed those Instructions. Again car got fixed. They left garbage in my car but took my quarters when they cleaned it. If you use them just make sure you take all your stuff.

reviews.author: Paula Attanasio
reviews.text: Personable, attentive, good follow-up and follow thru, will work with vs you on price, results were great! Felt like they cared about my car and their business reputation!

reviews.author: Bernadette Myers
reviews.text: My experience with Wreck O Mend was exceptional. The team was extremely helpful especially Irvine. Irvine is a true professional with outstanding customer service. He kept me updated daily with the status on my car. I appreciate all of the hard work from everyone that worked on my car. My car is looks brand new thanks to Wreck O Mend!!! Highly recommend!

reviews.author: Lori Gonzalez
reviews.text: Quick reliable service! There was frequent communication with Enrique on the progress of repairs. He was overall great to work with. Highly recommend!

reviews.author: Ronnie Dougherty
reviews.text: I was so impressed with the professionalism and excellent quality of work that I encountered at Wreck O Mend. The staff was friendly and respectful. They explained the process and had my car ready as promised. I appreciated the ongoing communication and would recommend them without any hesitation.

reviews.author: Josh Feinstein
reviews.text: Pete and his team did an amazing job on my 2006 Honda Accord. I needed to have my bumper, grille, radiator and headlights replaced. Not only did they do a tremendous job at a reasonable price, Pete was able to secure the parts quickly for me and have my car ready two days after being given the estimate. Pete's communication and explanations of the work that needed to be done were really appreciated. If you need any auto body work, look no further than Wreck O Mend.

reviews.author: Lisa C-Wolff
reviews.text: What a fantastic job Wreck O Mend did on our Jeep Compass! My husband was parked in the parking lot at his job 4th of July weekend and a young girl backed into the front bumper. Damage was minimal but still needed to be fixed. We choose Wreck O Mend and made the best choice. Pete was very helpful and communication was great! Headlight had to be replaced as well so nice to have the headlight condensation gone! Highly recommend this Auto Body shop! Thank you Wreck O Mend!!!

reviews.author: John Olsen
reviews.text: Towed my Tacoma here, that was badly damaged from hitting a deer. Pete and his crew were realistic with damage after an evaluation for an estimate. Decided not to go forward with the repair because I would rather spend money on a newer car. Pete and crew were helpful after I told them not to do the work. Thank you.

reviews.author: Heather HUneke
reviews.text: A big thank you to Pete and his staff for their professionalism and dedication to their customers. We have used Wreck O Mend for years now and they continue to surpass our expectations with the quality of their work. They are easy to work with and truly care about their customers. We highly recommend Pete and his staff!

reviews.author: Glorya Matthews
reviews.text: A big thank you to Peter and the staff of Wreck O Mend! My husband and I have used this business for our auto body repairs for over twenty years and they always exceed expectations. I highly recommend (no pun intended) this business for all your body work needs. Great service and attitude.

reviews.author: Nicole Lespoir
reviews.text: I highly recommend this auto body 100%! Their customer service is top notch as is their work! Enrique, my contact person kept me updated regularly as it related to the progress of the work being done on my car. One would never know that damage was done to the rear of my vehicle. The body work done was flawless! Plus they detailed the interior of the car too! A plus service all the way around!

reviews.author: Pam Kay
reviews.text: I was hit from behind and really shocked by the accident itself and the lack of concern from our insurance company. Wreck O Mend made a horrible experience, far easier to deal with. Their work was amazing and their customer service, exceptional. They dealt with Enterprise and a difficult situation was made seamless. I really couldn't ask for more and while I hope that I'm never in the position to visit them again, they are definitely our go to spot for any future repairs. Our car is my baby and I can tell you that it looks better than it did the day that we bought it. Thank you so much! This type of service is unheard of these days and we are truly appreciative! Highly recommended and A++++++ in every way.

reviews.author: Alexa Bartone
reviews.text: Amazing work done, wouldn't trust my car with any other auto body. Enrique did a great job communicating and updating me with the progress of the work. He went out of his way to make sure my car was finished and I was able to pick it up before the holiday weekend.

reviews.author: Ariel F
reviews.text: The experience Wreak-0-Mend was great! The service and employees were excellent! Irvin went above and beyond with fixing my car! Would highly recommend!

reviews.author: Lisa F
reviews.text: My husband and I took our car to have scratches taken out from a minor accident in a parking lot. The job was spectacular! Not only did it look brand new, but they were able to take all the tar buildup that was left from tree sap on my car. The staff is amazing, and so friendly! I highly recommend!!

reviews.author: Carm
reviews.text: Wreak-O-Mend is the place to go if your car needs body work. I had to bring my car in twice this year & the work they did is exceptional. They provide kind, friendly service & honest assessments. I highly recommend this business.

reviews.author: Katelyn Smith
reviews.text: These guys are seriously the nicest! Every person I spoke with so super polite and respectful on the phone. They kept me updated on the process and talked me through everything. They worked straight with my insurance company to make everything really easy and my car came back in perfect condition. Highly recommend!!

reviews.author: Keith Yurchak
reviews.text: Brought my vehicle here for an Insurance claim. Work came out good, upset a few parts were replaced that were not damaged at all. Radiator and condenser were replaced with cheap ones from Autozone.

reviews.author: Jennifer Z
reviews.text: Irvin and his staff did a great job fixing our car that was damaged by a tree limb in a storm. This involved body work, windshield replacement and paint. They have an excellent warranty, and all of my communications with the shop were pleasant and professional. Thank you for making a stressful time easier.

reviews.author: Shari Scaramuzzo
reviews.text: What a fabulous experience at Wreck O Mend in Howell! I’m so glad that my insurance agent at Duffy Financial Group, AllState of Eatontown sent me there for an estimate. My car was damaged in a parking lot hit and run. Wreck O Mend repaired the damage in less than 10 minutes and I didn’t need to file a claim!

reviews.author: Danielle
reviews.text: Ricardo was just great! My car was repaired and ready when promised. The entire process couldn’t have been easier. He made arrangements for a rental car .. kept me informed as to the progress of the repairs and even returned the car right to my house ! I would highly recommend them

reviews.author: Nikki Brissett
reviews.text: Someone did a hit and run on my new 2021 Subaru Legacy and Wreck O Mend was recommended to me by a friend. I was very pleased with my results as you can’t tell anything ever happened. Very clean and professional work.

reviews.author: Jack Licker
reviews.text: My Lincoln was rear ended and I was recommended to try Wreck O Mend. Irvin and Ricardo did a great job keeping me informed and did great work which was completed in one week. I really appreciate their quick and professional service.

reviews.author: Carlo Mannuzza
reviews.text: Unfortunately for me I have used Wreck-O-Mend twice for accidents on two cars and both times I was completely satisfied. Irwin was very professional and they did great work. When they are done you can't even tell that there was ever any damage.

reviews.author: Alan Levy
reviews.text: Very professional from the moment I walked into the business until I picked up my car. Continually updated me on the progress of repairs. I highly recommend Wreck O Mend!

reviews.author: Yvonne E
reviews.text: Amazing staff good care of my deer hit. My car looks brand new. The team goes above and beyond and kept us informed every step of the way. They deserve every single star on this review.

reviews.author: Laura Finlaw
reviews.text: This place was amazing. They advised me not to go through insurance so my rates wouldn't go up . Whereas they could have charged me my deductible plus perhaps some that insurance wouldn't pay he fixed my car on the spot. It looks great..I could not be happier with the service. They were friendly, courteous, professional and thorough. I am and will continue to recommend to all I know and am thankful for honest businesses . God bless them all

reviews.author: Judy Silletti
reviews.text: Through the years, I have had the opportunity to use the services of several body shops in the area. This establishment is so far above any of the others, it is unfathomable. From the friendliness and professionalism of the staff to the pristine condition of the premises to the timeliness of the work and most importantly the quality of the repair and fairness of the price, this business is a 10+++ in my book.

reviews.author: Barbara stonnell
reviews.text: Came in with what I thought was an expensive problem. Wreck O Mend showed me that it was easily fixed, right in front of me, and sent me on my way. Can't thank them enough and can't recommend Wreck O Mend enough!

reviews.author: pwrdbyoreos
reviews.text: Dropped my car off overnight without an appointment after losing a tire on RT 33 due to a pothole. Was called the next day and although I couldn't get a new tire, the team was very helpful and even put my spare tire on for me so I could get back home with the car. I highly recommend these guys for service and efficiency.

reviews.author: eleni d
reviews.text: WreckOMend did an amazing job on my BMW X3. Thank you to Thomas for the professional and courteous service! My car looks amazing and thanks to all of the great staff who worked on my car. Definitely recommend- WRECKOMEND!

reviews.author: Nika Stewart
reviews.text: Andrew went above and beyond to help with my car repair. I was kept in the loop during the whole process and the car looks better than before the accident.

reviews.author: Adam Rosenbaum
reviews.text: Peter, tomis, Angelo, irvin all are to deal with. We've been bringing our cars here for years and this is my first review so shame on me. If you're looking for a body shop that you can trust that does great work and that is honest works with most insurance companies be sure to bring your car here

reviews.author: Lauren Damico
reviews.text: Wreck o mend went above and beyond for us, we are so grateful we were able to work with them. We can’t thank Irvin and Pete enough for the work they have done for us! A great shop with even better people! We highly “wreck o mend” them, thank guys!

reviews.author: Elaina Malfa
reviews.text: I Got my appointment set up right away to fix my bumper from an accident I was in recently. Customer service was great- Staff is so friendly and attentive as well. Highly recommend !

reviews.author: Dianne Spatola
reviews.text: This place was great and communication was . They answer the phone, and were very informative about the details of the project which was completed by the estimated date..

reviews.author: Joe Burgio
reviews.text: Well, I don't love the fact that my car was wrecked and had to be here, but this is a first class operation. They were very professional and courteous. Did an amazing job on my car!

reviews.author: julie morawek
reviews.text: This shop is EXCELLENT! Very professional, polite, clean and all around friendly. The staff walks you through everything. They keep you informed. They work quickly and the repairs are perfect!

reviews.author: Bruce Gelbard
reviews.text: Very professional. Excellent communication and job was done in a timely manner. Car looked brand new when done

reviews.author: Stephanie DeCarlo
reviews.text: Couldn’t have asked for a better experience! Communication was great - clear and frequent. Customer service is exceptional. Their work is phenomenal and my repair was completed ahead of schedule. Thanks guys!

reviews.author: Bailey Hayes
reviews.text: I just wanted to shout out Irvin, he exceeded my expectations and finished sooner than expected. Stress free transaction and he made sure I would be happy with the results. Thanks Irvin!!

reviews.author: Michelle Davis
reviews.text: I have used them several times and highly recommend. Very professional and courteous. They complete the job in a very timely manner and communicate with you along the way.

reviews.author: nicole morley
reviews.text: I honestly cannot day enough good things about the staff here and their work. They were so awesome during such an awful time with my car. I would definitely go back here if I ever needed work again.

reviews.author: Shaun Buzzelli
reviews.text: Wreck O Mend did an absolutely amazing job with fixing the body damage on my car!! Thank you all so much!!

reviews.author: Giovanni Pecorelli
reviews.text: Amazing experience and great customer service. If your car needs work done this is the business I recommend.

reviews.author: Rob Nis
reviews.text: The whole team is tremendous. I can't thank them enough for all they have done especially Peter and Irvin.

reviews.author: Shiraz Hanif
reviews.text: Excellent service. Completed the repairs a day a head of schedule and Irvin kept me updated on progress.

reviews.author: Edward Guz
reviews.text: Professional, courteous, fair and prompt service. If you need competent auto body repair this is the place to go.

reviews.author: Gabriele Harper
reviews.text: This is the place to have your car repaired. Great service, courteous staff and most of all excellent work!

reviews.author: Wagner Menendez
reviews.text: Been knowing all they guys and the work they do. It's amazing how they always give their best to all customers Thank you!

reviews.author: Alyssia Barba
reviews.text: Peter and George were friendly, helpful, and made the whole process after my accident so easy. They handled everything with my insurance, the repairs were done quickly, and my car looks brand new. I highly recommend!

reviews.author: Luis Yunga
reviews.text: 100% recommend this shop. Very… VERY happy on how my 24’ wrx looks now, Pete thank you very much for helping me out. Thanks for the detail as well.
